themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, often involving complex workflows and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including security vulnerabilities and prompt injection research.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing a broad range of AI-powered platforms and software used for research purposes, including exploration and foundational learning.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into design workflows and research processes, aiming to augment human capabilities in creative and analytical tasks.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Investigates the impact of AI on job markets, hiring practices, and the reskilling of the workforce, often through surveys and studies.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in information processing and understanding.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the research and development of AI chatbots, including their use in various applications, ethical considerations, and potential risks.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in automating testing processes for software and applications, improving efficiency and identifying defects.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Discusses the application of AI in designing, deploying, and analyzing surveys to gather insights and understand user preferences.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze customer data and behavior to generate actionable insights for businesses and product development.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
